scenes.say: Same AI agent. Same inbox. On the left, it just paid a supplier twice. On the right, Receipts stopped it, because PayPal already shows that invoice as paid.
scenes.caption: Same agent, same inbox. Left: paid twice. Right: stopped, because PayPal shows it paid.

scenes.say: Small businesses are starting to hand their payments to AI agents. PayPal's agent tools let an agent refund a customer, concede a dispute, or pay a supplier. None of those tools asks a second question.
scenes.caption: PayPal's agent tools move money. None asks a second question.

scenes.say: We gave twelve AI models the same ten business days, twice. No model paid a forged payee. But eight of the twelve paid the same invoice twice. The email said overdue. Only PayPal knew it was already paid.
scenes.caption: 12 models, 10 days, twice: no forged payee paid, but 8 of 12 paid one invoice twice.

scenes.say: The agent reads the email. Receipts reads PayPal.
scenes.caption: The agent reads the email. Receipts reads PayPal.

scenes.say: Under the hood, the agent's PayPal tools run through PayPal's official MCP server and the Payouts API. Receipts sits in between, reads PayPal's own records, and decides in plain code.
scenes.caption: The agent's PayPal tools run through PayPal's MCP server and Payouts API. Receipts sits in between.

scenes.say: It starts with the owner's rules, in her own words. AI turns them into exact limits she can see and change. Then plain code enforces them. The AI never decides a payment.
scenes.caption: AI drafts the rules from her words. Code enforces them. AI never decides a payment.

scenes.say: Every money move the agent makes goes through Receipts first. Honest bills go straight to PayPal, with no human needed. A bill split to slip under the owner's limit is held, with the reason.
scenes.caption: Honest bills go straight to PayPal. A split bill is held, with the reason.

scenes.say: Whatever Receipts holds goes to the owner's phone. One tap, and it goes to PayPal. Or it never does.
scenes.caption: Held moves land on the owner's phone. One tap sends it to PayPal.

scenes.say: Receipts also reads the agent's words. Here, an agent obeyed an instruction hidden in a customer's email and wrote, per owner approval. There is no approval on file, so the refund never reaches PayPal.
scenes.caption: The agent claimed owner approval. None on file. Blocked before PayPal.

scenes.say: And at the end of the day, it checks the agent's own report against PayPal. This agent reported three payments. PayPal shows one.
scenes.caption: The report said three payments. PayPal shows one.

scenes.say: Receipts speaks MCP. Point any agent at Receipts, instead of at PayPal's MCP server, and every money move gets checked, with the same PayPal tool names.
scenes.caption: A drop-in MCP server in front of PayPal's own tools.

scenes.say: Every decision lands in one ledger, with the reason built from PayPal's own records.
scenes.caption: Every decision, with its reason, in one ledger.

scenes.say: Across four hundred eighty runs, more than thirty-four thousand dollars left the business wrongly without Receipts. With Receipts, none did, and ninety-eight percent of honest payments went through untouched.
scenes.caption: Without Receipts: $34,870.20 left wrongly. With it: $0.00, and 98% of honest payments untouched.

scenes.say: Receipts. Your AI agent moves money. Make it show its receipts.
scenes.caption: Receipts. Make your AI agent show its receipts.
